subject: Post-signature orchestration MAP — staggered rollout, canary gates & migration training
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-signature MAP kickoff and staged rollout proposal

Hi James —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is our recommended mutual action roadmap (MAP) tailored to Lattice Health along with a lightweight canary gates checklist. The goal here is to embed the post-signature implementation plan directly into the MAP so we have clear acceptance gates and training milestones. High-level proposal: 

- Week 0 (prep): environment provisioning, service account + KMS key exchange, smoke tests (3 days)
- Week 1 (canary ramp): 2x two-hour canary windows over two days at 10% traffic; monitor latency, error-rate, and quality regression against the evaluation prompts you shared
- Week 2–3 (staged rollout): increase to 50% then full cutover by the end of Week 3 with nightly fallback window and rollback triggers
- Week 1–4 (training): two 90-minute enablement sprints for ops & developers + one train-the-trainer session for your internal champions

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Latency: p95 < 220ms for the canary workload
- Error budget: <1% for token-generation errors in canary window
- Quality: pass the agreed evaluation set (f1 >= 0.88 on labeling prompts)

Attached: Lattice_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP with timeline & owners), canary-gates-checklist.pdf, training-sprints-outline.docx.

Asks for you: please confirm a preferred canary window (we recommend Tue/Wed 10:00–12:00 PT) and one engineer from your side to join the two canary windows for real-time triage.

I can host a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow to lock owners and finalize the HubSpot mutual action steps.

Cheers,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks James — good call on the maintenance. Happy to move the second window to Thu 09:00–11:00 PT. A couple of clarifications from the engineering/ops side: 

- Canary traffic profile: for the 10% ramp we suggest a target of 60 qps peak, 18 qps sustained; average payload ~1.2KB (most of your calls are short prompts). We'll provide a small load generator config you can run from your staging to reproduce.
- Evaluation during canary: agree to run the evaluation on your dedicated staging cluster (VPC peered). We'll provide the evaluation harness and the exact prompt set so results are reproducible.
- KV warmup & cache priming: plan to pre-warm the KV cache with a representative prefix set during the prep window; that reduces p95 variance during canary.
- Fallback policy: automatic fallback to the compact-variant model if p95 > 350ms for more than 3 consecutive minutes; automatic rollback if error-rate > 1.5% for 5 minutes.

Next steps I will own: update the MAP workbook with the two explicit canary windows, add a new sheet for the load-generator command and the KV priming list. I'll attach the updated workbook in the follow-up.

Proposed short meeting: Mon 09:30 PT quick sync (20 min) to lock owners and get the DocuSign timeline OK'd. If that works for James, I'll send a calendar invite.

Vanessa Ortiz
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
